brief: Berlin running community and store (Kreuzberg). Announcement: the “Night 10K” — a free, untimed group run on the old Tempelhof airfield runways, Friday 22 May, start 21:00, 400 spots, headlamps provided, afterparty at the store with a DJ. Audience: Berlin runners and curious beginners 22–40. Channel: Instagram feed. CTA: sign up via link in bio (stride.berlin).
